artworks.title: Two Cow's Heads [verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse's head in two different poses. The sketch displays the profile of a horse's head drawn in a minimalist style with simple, flowing lines that capture the essence of the animal's structure and musculature. The horse’s head is drawn twice on the page, each representation focusing on different angles. The sketch includes key features like the eyes, nostrils, and outlines of the mane, rendered with light, swift strokes. The drawing emphasizes movement and form through its concise and expressive linework on a plain, unadorned background.

artworks.title: Head of a Bearded Man with a Head of a Dog [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch on a beige or cream piece of paper. It depicts a rough drawing of a person's head and shoulders with facial features, including small, dark eyes, a prominent nose, a beard, and mustache. The person has medium-length dark hair styled to one side. Below the person's face is a simple outline of a dog's face with floppy ears, eyes, and a rounded nose. The background is plain with the paper's natural texture.

artworks.title: A Bearded Man and a Man in Profile [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image includes two partial sketches of men's faces and handwritten text. The first sketch, at the top right, shows about half of a man's face with a bowed head, downward curved eyebrows, a full beard, a short haircut, and a hat. The second sketch, below the first, is a side profile of another man with a prominent nose, pointed chin, neatly combed back hair, a thin mustache, and a collared garment. The sketches are surrounded by handwritten numbers and words, resembling a list or calculations, in faded pencil script. The background is plain and untextured, similar to aged paper.

artworks.title: Figure Seated on the Ground [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an individual's upper body in a reclining position, with one arm extended to the side and the other arm resting on a surface. The facial features are not detailed, and the head has an oval shape with a hint of a cap or head covering. The hair is suggested beneath the head covering. The person is dressed in a loose, long-sleeved garment, indicated by broad lines for the sleeves and upper torso. There are no jewelry or objects depicted. The background is a plain, unadorned surface.

artworks.title: Studies of a Cow [verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the outline of an animal. The image consists of loose, gestural lines sketching the form of a four-legged animal. The drawing captures the basic contours of the animal's face and torso with minimal detail. The lines are soft and slightly irregular, contributing to the spontaneous and natural feel of the piece. The simplicity of the lines highlights the fluidity of form and captures the essence of the animal rather than a detailed representation.

artworks.title: A Man Leaning on a Wall with Five Other Studies; Two Bearded Men Wearing Hats, and Five Other Studies [recto]
artworks.description: The image consists of sketches on two panels. On the left panel, there is a person viewed from behind leaning on a bar or railing, depicted from head to toe wearing a hat. Additional smaller sketches surround this figure, including facial profiles and headwear. The right panel primarily focuses on facial profiles and heads in different styles of headgear, such as caps and hats. The facial features are minimally detailed with simple lines. The sketches are done in pencil on a lightly colored paper, with a blank background.

artworks.title: Three Studies of Men's Heads, One with Spectacles; Dogs, Children, and Two Bearded Men in Profile [verso]
artworks.description: The image contains two pages filled with various pencil sketches. The left page shows sketches of individuals focusing on their head and shoulder areas. The top sketch depicts a person's face in partial profile with a head covering. Another sketch shows a back view of two individuals wearing hats. The right page also contains sketches of people, including two children and two dog-like animal figures in a sitting position. The background is plain with sketch marks and no additional context.

artworks.title: Two Figures and a Bench; Three Studies of Men's Heads and One of a Hand [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite, crayon, and pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two pages with pencil sketches. The left page features an abstract human figure with indistinct lines. The sketches on the right page include a head with partial facial features and a textured cap, a figure with a large nose and slicked-back hair, and a hand holding a paper or card. Light pencil notes, a name, and an address are visible above the sketches. The background is plain paper, and the pages are framed within a simple border.

artworks.title: A Breton Woman Walking; Sketch with Stairs [verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two distinct sketches. The left panel features a rapidly drawn, sketch-like depiction of the back of a figure in motion or leaning forward. The right panel showcases a more abstract collection of lines and shapes, with a focus on horizontal and vertical lines, cloud-like forms, and other abstract shapes. The drawing is minimalistic, with fast, gestural strokes as the primary technique.

artworks.title: Two Head Studies and a Crouching Nude Woman; Two Women's Heads and a Head of Child [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: There are two panels on beige paper with sketches of heads and partial upper bodies. The left panel has two facial sketches, one in profile with a notable nose and messy hair, and another with closed eyes and basic facial features. The right panel shows more sketches, including a profile of a person wearing a hat with a ribbon, another profile with hair tied at the back, and a partial head with combed-back hair. The sketches are done with simple lines and shading, suggesting quick observational studies. The panels are separated by thin lines resembling a sketchbook.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Cottage; Profile of Boy, Profile of Man, Two Women in a Landscape, and Five Other Studies [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing with various sketches. The left side shows a landscape with a tree, a structure with a window, and a distant view. The right side has sketches of a child's face, a face in profile, and figures engaged in different activities. There are abstract features like a hat and figure outlines focusing on gestures and expressions. The ink drawing captures an artist's exploration of landscape and human form.

artworks.title: Landscape and Head of Man; Head of Monkey Inside a Square [recto]
artworks.description: The image contains two sketched portraits on a paper. The left portrait is of a man with short hair and a cap, wearing a jacket. There are faint lines suggesting a tree and landscape around him. The right portrait is of a person with slightly longer, unkempt hair, showing a worried expression. The background is plain with no color or intricate details.

artworks.title: Four Heads and Two Figures [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of people on the left side of a dual-panel setup. The sketches depict individuals from different angles and positions, focusing on the shoulders up or in profile, and a few from the back up to the waist. The sketches are simplistic, with minimal details like facial expressions or clothing details. The people wear various types of hats. The background is neutral, emphasizing the sketched figures.

artworks.title: Little Breton Boy; A Pig and a Washerwoman [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows two sections on the same canvas. On the left side, a partial view of a person is depicted, facing forward in a wide-brimmed hat. The person's facial features are minimal, with faint lines indicating eyes. The right side displays rough sketches in black ink, including an animal resembling a horse, two figures in varying positions, and a simple shape suggesting an object or another animal. The background is plain with the texture of the paper visible, and no specific objects or jewelry are present in the sketches.

artworks.title: A Pig; Breton Peasant Kneeling [verso]
artworks.medium: crayon and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image has two separate sketches side by side in a single frame. On the left, there is a simple line drawing of an animal resembling a horse, shown in profile with minimal detail and soft brushstrokes, surrounded by abstract shapes. On the right, a colored sketch depicts a person kneeling on the ground with one hand touching the ground, wearing a short-sleeved top with hints of red, green, and blue, a cap or headscarf, and a draped lower garment, all in broad pastel strokes. The background is a plain, light beige in both sketches.

artworks.title: Manuscript Pages [recto]
artworks.medium: page of notes; pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a photograph of two pages of handwritten notes or a letter. The text is written in a cursive script with dark ink against a yellowed background. Each page is bordered with a lined margin and displays neat handwriting with slight variations in spacing and slant. There are visible corrections in the handwriting. Each page features a different block of text. The document appears to carry a formal yet personal tone.

artworks.title: Manuscript Pages [verso]
artworks.medium: page of notes; pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an old handwritten document. The document is spread across two columns and consists of neatly penned text in a cursive style. The text is written in French. There are sections of the text that are crossed out. The paper has a yellowed tone and is bordered by a thin line that frames each column.

artworks.title: Two Breton Figures; Bridge at Pont-Aven [recto]
artworks.description: The image contains two panels. The left panel shows rough sketches of human figures and shapes drawn with light lines. The right panel depicts a group of buildings with triangular rooftops, painted in pastel shades with figures nearby. The sky above the buildings is softly colored in yellow and grey tones.

artworks.title: Two Breton Figures and Studies of Two Geese; Man Wearing Hat [verso]
artworks.description: The image features two panels with simplistic sketches of figures. The left panel shows abstract representations of figures, with one appearing to show the back of a person wearing a hat. The right panel shows a more defined drawing of a person's head and shoulders, wearing a wide-brimmed hat with minimal facial features. The drawing style is sketchy and rough, focusing on outlines rather than details. The background of both panels is a plain, light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Manuscript Pages [recto]
artworks.medium: page of notes; pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a photograph of handwritten text on a piece of paper. The image contains two pages of writing with cursive script. The text appears dense, with sentences aligned carefully on both pages, and is framed by a simple rectangular border. The margins are narrow, emphasizing the text within. The handwriting displays a fluid style with loops and elegant curves typical of elaborate cursive handwriting. The alignment suggests this may be a carefully composed letter or manuscript page, and the paper has aged slightly, showing a light yellow or sepia tone.

artworks.title: Manuscript Pages [verso]
artworks.medium: page of notes; pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: A photograph of handwritten text on stationery. The image shows two columns of cursive handwriting in French covering the page. The stationery has decorative borders framing the text. The handwriting is neatly arranged and consistent, with even spacing between lines.

artworks.title: Eye and Part of Face; A Breton Woman and Two Men [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite and crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing with abstract sketches on a sheet. The sketches are separated by a thin line. On the left side, there is an abstract sketch with an eye-like form surrounded by shaded areas and flowing lines. On the right side, there are three bust and head sketches of varying detail. One sketch has simplified linework, another appears to depict a person with a head covering, and a more detailed profile of a figure with a thoughtful pose and one arm bent. The drawing has sparse and light pencil shading.

artworks.title: A Caricature and Five Forms; A Man in Profile, a Winged Creature and a Boy [verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various sketches on a two-page spread. The left page features abstract sketches, including a profile with geometric features, a circular figure, a simple head form, and other line drawings. Some cursive writing is present alongside these sketches. The right page contains more detailed sketches such as a person wearing a hat and coat, and two figures composed of quick lines. The drawings are executed with a rough and fluid hand, emphasizing lines and shapes.

artworks.title: Three Studies of a Pig; Breton Boy Walking with a Jug [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: A young boy is depicted in a three-quarter view, with his full length shown from head to toe. He stands facing to the right, with his head turned slightly. The boy has short hair and wears a wide-brimmed hat, partially obscuring his facial features. His clothing consists of a loosely fitted, long-sleeved shirt and pants in shades of blue with sketchy lines. He carries a large jug or pot by its handle in one hand, held beside his leg. The background is loosely sketched with patches of green and yellow. On the left side of the image, there are rough sketches of bovines and parts of a landscape, including simple outlines and incomplete shapes. The background on the left is plain and uncolored.
